biggest_catch: REJECTED: LifePoints is a real, operating panel (Lightspeed LLC/Kantar; its official US page says it paid over $22M to members in the last year), but the company publishes NO concrete payout terms publicly — no points-to-cash conversion, no minimum redemption, no timing — the rewards catalog is only visible inside a logged-in account, and figures vary by country in third-party reports. Without company-published payout figures, c2 fails.
catches: Official public pages (lifepoints site + lifepoints.zendesk.com help center) describe how to redeem (Profile > Rewards tab) but state no conversion rate, minimum, or processing time.
Third-party reports conflict: 550 LifePoints = $5 gift cards vs 1,200 points = $10 PayPal vs 5,500-point minimums — none from LifePoints itself.
The official 'How do I redeem my LifePoints?' help article confirms PayPal funds 'credited within 3-5 working days' but gives no point amounts.
Official signup bonus (10 LifePoints) has no stated cash value.

c1.evidence: LifePoints is operated by Lightspeed LLC (Kantar); the official LifePoints US page states 'In the last year, we've paid over $22 million (USD) to our members!' and offers a 10-LifePoints signup bonus. Real, operating panel.

c2.evidence: FAILED: no concrete payout terms published by LifePoints itself. Official pages and the official Zendesk help center give redemption mechanics but no points-to-cash conversion, no minimum redemption amount, and no reward values — those live behind login and vary by country.

c3.evidence: Membership is free; no participation fee found.

c4.evidence: Official LifePoints US page and lifepoints-insights.zendesk.com help article obtained, but neither contains concrete payout figures.

eligibility: Free registration (name, email); 10 LifePoints signup bonus. Surveys 10-20 minutes; screen-outs pay ~2 LPs (third-party reported).
notes: Reject is strictly on c2, not c1 — the company is real and paying. If LifePoints publishes a public rewards-terms page with concrete conversion rates and minimums, this route can be re-verified.

s1.note: Free registration; no official eligibility restrictions published beyond account signup.

s2.note: No fees; but no official point values either, so effective costs cannot be assessed.

s3.note: Official help article says PayPal funds credited within 3-5 working days — but with no stated point cost, timing alone is not a payout term.

s4.note: N/A — no official payout figures to evaluate.

s5.note: https://lifepoints-insights.zendesk.com/hc/en-gb/articles/360001693108-How-do-I-redeem-my-LifePoints — official help center, but no payout figures.

s6.note: Cannot build concrete steps without official payout figures.

s7.note: Official pages retrieved 2026-09-23; no payout figures in them.

timing: PayPal credit within 3-5 working days per official help article — but the point cost of rewards is not published.
